التقيت (form VIII)
# اِلْتَقَيْتُ (iltaqaytu) /il.ta.qaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اِلْتَقَيْتَ (iltaqayta) /il.ta.qaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اِلْتَقَيْتِ (iltaqayti) /il.ta.qaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اُلْتُقِيتُ (ultuqītu) /ul.tu.qiː.tu/: first-person singular
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
